COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, basophilia, elevated ferritin, LDH, D-dimer, and INR, with low CO₂ and mild metabolic acidosis. These findings suggest a significant inflammatory or infectious process, possibly with hypoxic respiratory failure and risk of coagulopathy. Urgent clinical evaluation is recommended.
